liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Doll** (3 reviews): Second set highlight is China Doll leading into the Playin' jam; The move from Playin' down into China Doll is called unusual and very good [29][30][31]
- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out Bird Song as a great version in a blistering first set; Reviewer calls the first-set Bird Song a killer, with Garcia playing authoritatively [28][33]
- **Playin' In The Band Reprise** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer loves the return to Playin' out of Space, wishing the band did it more; The Playin' space segment is included within the Playin' In The Band Reprise track [1][33]
- **She Belongs To Me** (2 reviews): Closing the show with She Belongs To Me is called a rare treat; She Belongs To Me served as a second encore [29][33]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): The China Cat Sunflower to I Know You Rider transition is praised as especially good [30]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Reviewer finds Crazy Fingers not the best version, but still enjoys hearing it [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-04-28.148418.fob.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 143 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1985-04-28.145342.fob.sony.ecm150.keeler.miller.noel.t-flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 144 min [3]
- **gd1985-04-28.143492.FOB.ECM150.Keeler.Miller.Noel.t-flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 144 min [4]
- **gd1985-04-28.124404.nak700.wagner.miller.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 143 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd85-04-28.sbd.barbella.14192.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 134 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [14]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard is properly mixed and works well on any playback, though earphones are recommended [24]
- **gd85-04-28.sbd.new.miller.28439.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 134 min; rated 3.6/5 by 10 [15]. Said about its sound: Charlie Miller's upgraded transfer is called the best of the listed versions, clear and crisp; Reviewer describes the recording as great sounding [25][30]

## Around the show

- Brent's keyboard playing is described as aggressively challenging, pushing hard throughout the show [28]
- Reviewer hears Garcia's voice as rough, as if from too many cigarettes that weekend [32]
- The show ended with encores of U.S. Blues and She Belongs To Me [5]
- Reviewer names 1985 as their favorite year at Frost, crediting this show as a big reason [27]
- Reviewer calls the show as intense and in-your-face as 1985 gets, and often overlooked [28]
- Reviewer prefers the previous night's show to this one, calling it a personal preference [34]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-04-28.148418.fob.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Neumann KM84i mics > Sony D5M [1]. Also: A Nakamichi 700 source from Bob Wagner supplies the crowd, the start of Gimme Some Lovin', and a short Drums patch [1]
- **gd1985-04-28.145342.fob.sony.ecm150.keeler.miller.noel.t-flac16**: taped by Walt Keeler; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: Walt Keeler (FOB) Recording: Sony ECM-150 > Sony WM-D6C > Master Audience Cassette (Maxell XLII-S 90) [3]. Also: Greg Holtz supplied the patch source for this version [3]
- **gd1985-04-28.143492.FOB.ECM150.Keeler.Miller.Noel.t-flac2496**: taped by Walt Keeler; transferred by Joe Noel and Charlie Miller; source: Walt Keeler (FOB) Recording: Sony ECM-150 > Sony WM-D6C > Master Audience Cassette (Maxell XLII-S 90) [4]
- **gd1985-04-28.124404.nak700.wagner.miller.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLII-S90) [5]. Also: Nakamichi 700 recording from Bob Wagner's masters, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones [5]
- **gd85-04-28.sbd.barbella.14192.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Reel > DAT > CD [14]
- **gd85-04-28.sbd.new.miller.28439.sbeok.flacf**: source: flac16 **NEW UPGRADE** Source Updated CD Burner changedRecording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> CD (Marantz CDR 500 Pro)Transfer Info: CD -> EAC… [15]

claims.text: Reviewer says the soundboard is properly mixed and works well on any playback, though earphones are recommended
Charlie Miller's upgraded transfer is called the best of the listed versions, clear and crisp
Reviewer names 1985 as their favorite year at Frost, crediting this show as a big reason
Reviewer singles out Bird Song as a great version in a blistering first set
Brent's keyboard playing is described as aggressively challenging, pushing hard throughout the show
Reviewer calls the show as intense and in-your-face as 1985 gets, and often overlooked
Second set highlight is China Doll leading into the Playin' jam
Reviewer finds Crazy Fingers not the best version, but still enjoys hearing it
Closing the show with She Belongs To Me is called a rare treat
Reviewer describes the recording as great sounding
The move from Playin' down into China Doll is called unusual and very good
The China Cat Sunflower to I Know You Rider transition is praised as especially good
Reviewer finds the end of China Doll, going into the jam, very different and even better
Reviewer hears Garcia's voice as rough, as if from too many cigarettes that weekend
Reviewer calls the first-set Bird Song a killer, with Garcia playing authoritatively
Reviewer loves the return to Playin' out of Space, wishing the band did it more
She Belongs To Me served as a second encore
Reviewer prefers the previous night's show to this one, calling it a personal preference
Master recording by Chris Hecht from a Neumann KM84 FOB source, transferred by Charlie Miller
A Nakamichi 700 source from Bob Wagner supplies the crowd, the start of Gimme Some Lovin', and a short Drums patch
The Playin' space segment is included within the Playin' In The Band Reprise track
Sony ECM150 front-of-board source, transferred by Charlie Miller, edited and mastered by Joe Noel; this set is 16-bit
Greg Holtz supplied the patch source for this version
ECM150 front-of-board source from Keeler, transferred by Miller, mastered by Joe Noel as 24/96 FLAC
Nakamichi 700 recording from Bob Wagner's masters, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones
The show ended with encores of U.S. Blues and She Belongs To Me
